title: Data Contracts: Aligning Teams on Data

scenes.line1: How do teams avoid data surprises?
scenes.say: How do teams avoid data surprises and downtime? What’s a data contract?

scenes.label: Contract
scenes.sub: Formal agreement on schema, quality, and delivery.
scenes.say: A data contract is a formal agreement on schema, quality, and delivery between data producers and consumers.
For example, a contract might specify: customer ID is an integer, must be unique, delivered daily by 7am, and no nulls allowed.
With contracts, roles are clear and surprises are rare. Without them, you risk breaking changes and downtime.

scenes.question: Are data contracts just documentation?
scenes.right: No—they’re enforceable agreements on data quality and delivery.
scenes.say: Here’s a common trap: Are data contracts just documentation? No—they’re enforceable agreements on data quality and delivery.
